system.description:
Lore: Relic Orb (Bound)

Nass Lantomir wanted one badly enough to die over it. It has the following Powers:

  • Scrying: Gaze into it to Scry on a Being or place you name, seeing and hearing it as though standing there. An unwilling Being resists with [Will], and knows it is being watched on a pass.
  • True-Seeing: While Scrying, the viewer sees through illusions, invisibility and disguises within the scried area.

Value: 50000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
